source: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), Ministry of Home Affairs & Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
notes: TODO: Emergency numbers verified with I4C guidelines. Requires review for state-specific cyber cell escalation channels.

scenarios.title: UPI / QR Code / Unauthorized Debit Scam
scenarios.description: Scammer sent a QR code claiming 'Scan to receive money' or debited money via fake merchant links.
scenarios.criticalAlert: Rule: You NEVER enter your UPI PIN to receive money. A PIN is required solely to SEND money.
immediateActions: Call 1930 IMMEDIATELY (within the 2-hour Golden Hour) to freeze beneficiary accounts.
Open your UPI app (GPay/PhonePe/Paytm) and report the transaction under 'Payment Fraud'.
Call your bank customer care to hotlist debit cards and block net-banking access.

scenarios.title: Hacked Social Media or Email Account
scenarios.description: Lost access to WhatsApp, Instagram, or Gmail account; hacker asking contacts for money.
scenarios.criticalAlert: Post a status/warning from a family member's phone alerting friends not to send any money.
immediateActions: Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) with an authenticator app on all secondary accounts.
Report cyber impersonation on cybercrime.gov.in under 'Cyber Crime Against Women/Children' or 'Other Cyber Crimes'.

scenarios.title: Fake Job / Telegram Task Investment Scam
scenarios.description: Promised high returns for liking YouTube videos, rating hotels, or crypto trading on a fake portal.
scenarios.criticalAlert: Any scheme promising 20-50% guaranteed daily returns is an illegal Ponzi/fraud scheme.
immediateActions: Stop sending any further 'tax clearance' or 'withdrawal fees' money immediately.
Export and save full Telegram / WhatsApp chat logs and crypto/bank wallet addresses.
File a detailed complaint on cybercrime.gov.in mentioning the channel admins and bank account details.

scenarios.title: Counterfeit E-Commerce & Fake Delivery Link
scenarios.description: Ordered from an Instagram ad or clicked an SMS link claiming 'Parcel delayed - update KYC'.
scenarios.criticalAlert: Do not download any APK files (e.g. AnyDesk, RustDesk, QuickSupport) sent via WhatsApp.
immediateActions: Uninstall any unrecognized app downloaded recently.
Disconnect phone from Wi-Fi/data and restart in safe mode if remote screen sharing was enabled.
Report the fake merchant website URL to cybercrime.gov.in.

scenarios.title: SIM Swap & Identity Theft
scenarios.description: Phone suddenly lost mobile network signal after a fake telecom verification call.
scenarios.criticalAlert: A sudden network loss accompanied by unauthorized OTP notifications indicates an active SIM swap attack.
immediateActions: Contact your telecom operator (Jio/Airtel/Vi) from another number to block your SIM instantly.
Alert your bank to pause SMS-based OTP authorization for 48 hours.
Visit your telecom store with original Aadhaar to reissue your physical SIM.

checklist.name: Act Immediately (The Golden Hour)
checklist.action: Dial 1930 to connect to the Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting System. Have your 12-digit transaction UTR number and bank name ready. Police will coordinate with banks to freeze recipient accounts in real-time.

checklist.name: Collect & Preserve Evidence
checklist.action: Take uncropped screenshots of SMS messages, bank passbook/statement entries, UPI transaction details, caller phone numbers, and WhatsApp/Telegram chats. Do not delete fraudulent chats.

checklist.name: File Formal Portal Complaint
checklist.action: Visit cybercrime.gov.in within 24 hours. Submit the detailed incident report with all screenshots attached. Note down the 14-digit Complaint Acknowledgment Number.

checklist.name: Bank Redressal & RBI Ombudsman
checklist.action: Submit a physical copy of the cyber complaint to your home bank branch within 3 days. Under RBI Circular DBR.No.Leg.BC.78/09.07.005/2017-18, reporting unauthorized electronic transactions within 3 days ensures zero liability for the customer if bank systems were compromised.
